description: David (David Protein) is a US protein-bar brand built around high-protein, low-sugar bars, and runs an ambassador program through Superfiliate that pays commission on referred new customers' first purchases.

evidence.summary: David's own ambassador page, fetched first-hand, publishes the program terms: ambassadors earn commission on a referred new customer's first purchase through their unique link, eligible ambassadors receive a free sample pack, commissions are paid in the first week of each month via PayPal, Venmo or ACH, and the attribution window is 7 days, with applications running through the brand's Superfiliate portal. The page publishes no commission percentage, so commission_rate is null. No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown; no creator-count data is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

description: OraWellness is a US oral-health brand selling natural tooth and gum care products since 2010, and runs an affiliate program through Refersion paying 20% commission with recurring earnings on Subscribe & Save orders.

evidence.summary: OraWellness's own affiliate sign-up page, fetched first-hand, publishes a 20% commission rate, long-term tracking (180 days), recurring commissions on Subscribe & Save orders, quarterly payouts by the 5th of January, April, July and October, and a $20 minimum payout, with affiliate accounts managed through the brand's Refersion portal. The program requires a health or wellness website or social following (minimum 5,000 followers), US or Canada base with an EIN/SSN, and does not accept coupon-site promotion. The published 20% rate is recorded. No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown; no creator-count data is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.
